description:
Entrance is restricted to third- and fourth-year students who meet the prerequisites specified for the offered topic.

* Lab hours may vary depending on the topic.
repeatableCatalogText: May be taken more than once for credit in different topics with permission of the department.
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 483A, CSC 483 (if taken in the same topic), CSC 483B (if taken in the same topic), CSC 483C (if taken in the same topic), CSC 483D (if taken in the same topic).
